name: Adhirchi Arun
bio: Adhirchi Arun is an Indian actor and digital creator who transitioned from popular Tamil YouTube channel "Black Sheep" to feature films. He is recognized for his comedic performances in regional cinema, including the movie Baba Black Sheep.

credits.title: Haiku
credits.overview: A charismatic young man uses poetry to navigate the complex maze of modern romance to protect his fragile relationship. Later, he must overcome deep generational divides to keep his love alive.

credits.title: Happy Raj
credits.overview: A city romance meets a rural family invasion. What follows is chaos, comedy, and heartfelt moments. The story unfolds as a joyful entertainer that explores love, cultural clashes, and the importance of family bonds.

credits.title: Baba Black Sheep
credits.overview: Two rival school gangs come under the same management and are forced to co-exist, leading to several changes in their lives. As things progress, the students not only become close to each other but also teach the value of life, literally.
